mapper.sql: C.COST_ID AS costId, C.SUIT_ID AS suitId, C.COST_KIND_CD AS costKindCd, CK.CODE_NM AS costKindNm, C.COST_AMT AS costAmt, C.COST_DESC AS costDesc, C.PAY_DMND_DT AS payDmndDt, C.REG_DT AS regDt, S.COURT_NM AS courtNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm
FROM LAW_SUIT_COST C JOIN LAW_SUIT S ON S.SUIT_ID = C.SUIT_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE CK ON CK.CODE_ID = 'LAW_COST_KIND' AND CK.CODE = C.COST_KIND_CD
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_SUIT_COST SET COST_KIND_CD = #{costKindCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COST_AMT = #{costAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, COST_DESC = #{costDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_DMND_DT = #{payDmndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE COST_ID = #{costId}
